Security checklist applies (orchestrator/*.py). Verdict approve only if the block path is fully restored and no other behaviour of jev_gate.run changed beyond the shadow logging. If request_changes, name the exact line and the failing behaviour; the Planner files a follow-up execute task on goal/T-0760 (T-0809 is merged, there is no fix-round branch).
